label: Exteneral
description:
“The body is our general medium for having a world.”
 - Maurice Merleau-Ponty, Phenomenology of Perception

If the body is the medium through which the world is perceived and experienced, what happens when that world loses its coherence?

Exteneral (formed from the prefix ex- and the entomological term "teneral", the state of an organism newly emerged, still soft and not yet fully formed)  is an ongoing research project exploring body architectures as aesthetic and functional responses to forced evolution.

Adaptation is never innocent: a body altered for survival exists between evolution and violence, where enhancement may also be experienced as an invasion from within.

At its centre is this suspended state: the moment in which the former anatomy can no longer hold, while the next has not yet stabilised. 

Mutation is no longer a deviation from the system. It becomes the system itself.
